clusters.mechanism: signalCommand treats double-quoted tokens and non-interpreter (unquoted) heredoc bodies as inert literals, so command substitutions inside them that run kill/pkill are never detected or warned about.
jsSignal strips whole template literals, including executable ${...} interpolations, so process.kill inside an interpolation is missed.
Inline eval detection only recognizes separate --eval and code tokens, so the --eval=CODE form bypasses signal detection.

The new outer sandbox profile denies writes outside the checkout and scratch, but Codex still uses its default CODEX_HOME and persists sessions, so it cannot write its session/runtime state and fails to initialize.
